intro: Looking for your next escape? Hampi delivers: boulder landscapes and the ruins of Vijayanagara. Here is everything you need to plan a trip.

sections.heading: Why visit Hampi
paragraphs: Hampi (Karnataka) is known for its heritage, backpacking and boulders experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to February.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Vittala Temple and the stone chariot

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Overnight trains or buses to Hosapete (Hospet), about 30 minutes away.

sections.heading: Where to stay
list: Hampi Bazaar area for access to ruins
Hippie Island (Virupapur Gaddi) for chilled stays

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Rent a bicycle — the ruins are spread over a large area.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Hampi?

faq.a: Overnight trains or buses to Hosapete (Hospet), about 30 minutes away.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Hampi?
faq.a: Popular choices: Hampi Bazaar area for access to ruins; Hippie Island (Virupapur Gaddi) for chilled stays; Kamalapur for heritage hotels.
